answer: In the AGILE Index 2025, the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) that receive the most AI research attention are SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-Being), SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities), and SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure). High-income countries have allocated higher AI research attention to social-level SDGs, such as SDG 3, SDG 5 (Gender Equality), and SDG 16 (Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions). In contrast, upper-middle and lower-middle income countries have relatively higher AI research attention to economically and environmentally related SDGs, including SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation), SDG 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy), SDG 9, and SDG 11.
